text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm walking with Inari One to the track to begin our training session…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, someone's already here? Hm, who's that with Tickezo?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket is engaged in conversation with two students about something.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniff! I understand how you feel. That's why… I'm going to let you use the time I reserved on the track!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I-I'd just be in the way. So, I-I'm going to go back now. Waaaaaugh!
choice_data_list: Looks like trouble! Let's hurry and stop her—
Looks like trouble! Let's hurry and stop her—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Hold it right theeere!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa, pump your brakes! The heck ya think you're doin'?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tryin' to snatch someone's reserved track time! You've got some real guts!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wha? Inari? What do you mean "snatch"?

text_block_list.name: Blonde-Haired Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Tickezo! Inari's right! We couldn't let you give up your track time!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: In other words, you were talkin' about doin' your best to get ready for your debut, and Tickezo overheard?
choice_data_list: She was inspired, so she offered to give up her time on the track.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's right! While I was warming up, I overheard their conversation!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You talked about doing your best in the tryouts so you could one day compete as rivals in a G1!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Seeing the sparkle in your eyes made me want to help out! Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Younger Student
text_block_list.text: A-actually! I'm really happy you offered to help. I want all the time I can afford to train for my debut, but…

text_block_list.name: Blonde-Haired Younger Student
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't be right to achieve our dream by trampling over someone else's. That's why…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Now that…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: is CLASSY!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya think, Boss? How 'bout lettin' 'em use my training slot?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya think, Boss? How 'bout lettin' 'em use my training slot?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Seein' these girls bond over chasin' their dreams, and witnessin' Tickezo's bighearted kindness…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't sit right if I didn't lend a hand!
choice_data_list: Cool! Let's go for a run outside the academy!

text_block_list.name: Blonde-Haired Younger Student
text_block_list.text: W-we couldn't possibly impose on you! What about the track time you booked for your training?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What're ya talkin' 'bout? Who said I'm doin' this for you?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm doin' this for myself!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Repayin' class in style—that's just how we roll in Edo, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So don't sweat it! Just stand tall and run like the wind!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How about taggin' along, Tickezo? Me and you could do a few laps outside the grounds!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: OHHH! That'd be great! I'd love to do some partner running with you!

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Inari One and Winning Ticket run up and down the riverside until they're completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Maaan, this feels waaay better than runnin' on the track!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… It does! It feels really refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha! Runnin' with a classy partner makes it all the better!
choice_data_list: It's nice to train differently once in a while!
It's nice to train differently once in a while!
It makes me want to run too.
It makes me want to run too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha! Runnin' with a classy partner makes it all the better!
choice_data_list: It's nice to train differently once in a while!

It makes me want to run too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You bet! Plus, me and Tickezo are on the same wavelength, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I feel the same! Um, hey! Do you want to go for another run?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm game! C'mon, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of them continue running happily beneath the glow of the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, you said it! Ya heard that, didn'tcha, Tickezo?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I sure did! Okay, Trainer! On your mark, get set…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Run with everythin' ya got, and make sure ya finish with style!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I work up a good sweat chasing after the two as they run off along the riverside, beneath the glowing sunset.
